name: Oh Vicky!
description: Uruguayan online lingerie boutique selling bras, panties, bodysuits, shapewear and swimwear. Ships to all of Uruguay with free shipping over a purchase threshold and offers pickup in Montevideo.
description_es: Boutique online uruguaya de lencería que vende corpiños, bombachas, bodys, modeladores y línea de baño. Envía a todo Uruguay, con envío sin costo sobre un monto, y ofrece retiro en Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Delivery to all of Uruguay in 24 to 48 business hours (up to 72 in some cities); interior orders go by UES, per the store's shipping page.

search.notes: robots.txt disallows search URLs for generic crawlers, so the probe did not test this path.

shopping_notes: PrestaShop storefront. robots.txt disallows the internal search (search_query and controller=search), cart and account paths; browse by category instead.

sources.supports: Store home page: free-shipping banner and categories
Delivery options and times, UES to the interior, pickup in Montevideo
